caseStudies.title: Case Study 1: Cold Chain Security
caseStudies.challenge: Insulin is temperature-sensitive and a high-value target for tampering. The client needed to ensure integrity from the Ocala Distribution Center to the pharmacy.

solution.criticalEvent: A security seal breach detected during transit

outcome.instantFlag: currentStatus flipped to FLAGGED_SECURITY_BREACH the moment the seal broke.
outcome.aiAnalysis: Authenticity score dropped to 0.0, preventing the pharmacy from accidentally accepting the stock.
outcome.result: Compromised product was automatically rejected at the destination dock, protecting patient safety.

caseStudies.thumbnailHint: insulin vial + syringe over temperature scale

caseStudies.title: Case Study 2: Complex Assembly & Parts Batching
caseStudies.assetName: GO-Eagle Mk II Tactical Drone + Component Batch
caseStudies.challenge: How do we ensure every part inside a finished military drone is authentic and traceable before it deploys? Component swapping creates mission-critical failure risk.

solution.level1: NFC Tags on critical components (Battery, Flight Computer, Rotor)
solution.level2: UHF/NFC Master Chip on the Drone Chassis
solution.level3: Automated batching — one Master scan verifies presence and authenticity of all 20+ subcomponents

scenario.step: Technician installs Flight Controller #FC-X1 and Battery #BATT-99
Technician scans Master Chassis Tag; system batches parts to Master Record
Completeness check confirms all required parts present and authentic
Gate scanner reads Master Chip at the loading dock; departure logged

outcome.result: Total drone-level traceability and one-scan inspection without opening the crate.

caseStudies.thumbnailHint: tactical drone exploded view with NFC tags

caseStudies.title: Case Study 3: Mission Critical Logistics
caseStudies.challenge: Total asset visibility is required for sensitive munitions. The military needs to prevent theft/loss in transit without manual barcode scanning in austere environments.

solution.criticalEvent: Automated OBSERVE event at a transit hub confirms secure arrival

outcome.automatedScan: OBSERVE triggered by fixed reader, no soldier intervention required.
outcome.sealIntegrity: sealStatus confirmed still ARMED upon arrival.
outcome.result: Secure chain of custody for lethal aid with real-time confidence for logistics officers.

caseStudies.title: Bonus: Consumer Authentication
caseStudies.challenge: Close the regulatory compliance loop for state-controlled cannabis with consumer-facing proof of authenticity.

solution.mechanism: Consumer NFC mobile tap at licensed dispensary
solution.criticalEvent: Status auto-flips to 'Sold' on NFC tap with GPS-verified dispensary location

outcome.consumerBenefit: Instant access to Lab Results (COA) on consumer's phone.
outcome.result: Regulatory certainty + brand authentication in one tap.
